resources.string: No backup of your nights in the last 30 days.

Nights, coach state, profile and tags in a single file encrypted with a password you choose. Save it wherever you like: Google Drive, phone storage, computer. It does not include the Intervals.icu connection: after restoring on a new phone, connect it again.
From a .noctalix file (or .biosleep, for backups made before the name change). Before restoring you will see how many nights it contains and can cancel.
A CSV with one row per night, to open in a spreadsheet. The file is NOT encrypted: anyone who opens it can see your sleep and heart rate data.
Add the RR intervals of each night (zip file, larger)
You need it to open the backup again. If you forget it, the backup can no longer be opened: nobody can recover it.
Backup of %1$s (%2$s %3$s), with %4$s nights.\n\nThe nights on this phone will be replaced by those in the backup, together with the coach state, profile and tags.
